title: 第8章吓坏宁荣荣，想看我的武魂必须见血-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    宁荣荣听到叶寒这番话，怒气冲冲地走了过来。

    她虽然跟爸爸吵了一架，离家出走了，不想再回宗门。

    但她还是不允许任何人敢小瞧和轻视七宝琉璃宗。

    不管怎样，那里也是她长大的地方，有她的亲人。

    叶寒瞥了一眼有点骄纵蛮横，耍大小姐脾气的宁荣荣，眉头微微一皱，冷漠回道：“小瞧？我可没说过，我只是没有听说过七宝琉璃宗。”

    轰！

    在场所有人听到他的回答，脑海中一阵轰鸣。

    在斗罗大陆竟然还有人没听过七宝琉璃宗？

    这也太胡扯了吧。

    要知道，七宝琉璃宗是斗罗大陆最强大的三大宗门之一，声望极高。

    哪怕是一个普通老百姓都知道七宝琉璃宗的存在。

    这哥们怕是脑袋坏了，在故意找茬啊。

    “你......”

    宁荣荣听到叶寒的回答，气得她浑身直打哆嗦。

    她也是第一次遇见不知道七宝琉璃宗存在的人。

    一时之间，她都不知道该说什么了。

    “叶寒大哥，七宝琉璃宗是上三宗，是斗罗大陆最强大的三大宗门之一。”

    “其声望极高，拥有两名强大的封号斗罗，哪怕是两大帝国和势力最强的武魂殿也不敢小视。”

    朱竹清也有点懵了，不明白叶寒为何这么说。

    身为一名魂师，不可能没听说过七宝琉璃宗。

    叶寒有点无辜地耸了耸肩，回道：“我确实不知道。”

    “小子，你少在这里装蒜。”

    “我看你就是故意的。”

    “找打！”

    宁荣荣看到叶寒那有点无辜的脸庞，瞬间气炸了，抬起手，向他扇去。

    在她的眼里，叶寒并不是不知道，而是在故意装作不知道，羞辱七宝琉璃宗。

    叶寒看到宁荣荣的行为，脸色一冷，将她扇来的手腕握住，眼神中满是寒意。

    强劲的力量，像是一把用力的钳子，紧紧地扣在她的手腕上，痛得她都快哭了。

    宁荣荣哪儿受过这种苦，痛呼道：“你弄疼我了，给本小姐松开。”

    李郁松见宁荣荣的处境有点不好，赶紧走上前来阻止，“这位小兄弟，还是算了吧。”

    宁荣荣可是七宝琉璃宗的少主，若是在这里被外人欺负了，他们史莱克学院也逃不了责任。

    “叶寒大哥......”

    朱竹清虽然对宁荣荣刚才的刁蛮行为感到气愤，但她还是忍不住开口劝阻，免得把事情闹大了，不好收场。

    七宝琉璃宗还不是他们能得罪的。

    “嗯！”

    叶寒望着朱竹清恳求的眼神，点了点头，松开了手。

    但他在看向宁荣荣的眼神中却闪烁着冰冷的杀意。

    在场所有人感知到这股杀意，心神一震。

    尤其是李郁松，他在斗罗大陆生活了几十年，还是第一次遇到如此冷漠的少年。

    身上的杀意，更是罕见。

    此人绝对不简单，

    宁荣荣被叶寒的杀意和那冰冷到极致的眼神吓坏了，害怕地往后退了一步，“你，你这是什么眼神，信不信我让剑爷爷和骨爷爷收拾你。”

    “呵呵，是嘛！”

    “但我相信，你没有机会活着回去。”

    叶寒双眼微微一眯，身上的杀意变得更盛，吓得宁荣荣又退了一步。

    朱竹清生怕他冲动，紧紧地抓着他的胳膊，示意他不要冲动。

    “你......”

    宁荣荣已经被彻底吓坏了，哆嗦着嘴，不敢继续说下去了，深怕他动手。

    戴沐白、唐三和小舞看到这一幕，有点窃喜。

    尤其是戴沐白，他现在恨不得叶寒能直接动手，伤了宁荣荣。

    以七宝琉璃宗护短的性格，肯定会派人来找叶寒的麻烦。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Ning Rongrong heard what Ye Han said, he walked over angrily.

Although she had a quarrel with her father and ran away from home, she did not want to return to the sect.

But she still doesn’t allow anyone to dare to look down on or despise the Qibao Glazed Sect.

No matter what, that’s where she grew up and has her relatives.

Ye Han glanced at Ning Rongrong, who was a bit arrogant and arrogant, and had the temper of a young lady. He frowned slightly and replied coldly: "You're looking down on me? I never said that. I just haven't heard of the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect."

Boom!

When everyone present heard his answer, there was a roar in their minds.

There are still people in Douluo Continent who haven’t heard of the Qibao Glazed Sect?

This is too much nonsense.

You must know that the Qibao Glazed Sect is one of the three most powerful sects in Douluo Continent and has a very high reputation.

Even an ordinary citizen knows the existence of the Qibao Glazed Sect.

“I’m afraid this guy’s brain is broken and he’s deliberately looking for trouble.

"You..."

When Ning Rongrong heard Ye Han's answer, she was so angry that she trembled all over.

It was also the first time she met someone who didn’t know the existence of Qibao Glazed Sect.

For a moment, she didn’t know what to say.

"Brother Ye Han, the Qibao Glazed Sect is one of the top three sects and one of the three most powerful sects in Douluo Continent."

"Its reputation is extremely high, and it has two powerful titled Douluo. Even the two major empires and the most powerful Spirit Hall do not dare to look down upon it."

Zhu Zhuqing was also a little confused and didn't understand why Ye Han said that.

As a soul master, it’s impossible that you haven’t heard of the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect.

Ye Han shrugged innocently and replied: "I really don't know."

“Boy, stop pretending here.”

"I think you did it on purpose."

"Look for a fight!"

Ning Rongrong saw Ye Han's somewhat innocent face and instantly became furious. She raised her hand and slapped him.

In her eyes, it was not that Ye Han didn't know, but that he was deliberately pretending not to know and humiliating the Qibao Glazed Sect.

When Ye Han saw Ning Rongrong's behavior, his face turned cold, and he held the wrist she slapped, his eyes full of coldness.

The strong force, like a pair of strong pliers, clasped her wrist tightly, causing her to almost cry in pain.

Ning Rongrong had never experienced such pain before, and she cried out in pain: "You hurt me, please let me go."

Seeing that Ning Rongrong was in a bad situation, Li Yusong quickly stepped forward to stop him, "Little brother, let's forget it."

Ning Rongrong is the young master of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Sect. If they are bullied by outsiders here, Shrek Academy cannot escape responsibility.

"Brother Ye Han..."

Although Zhu Zhuqing was angry at Ning Rongrong's unruly behavior just now, she couldn't help but tried to dissuade her, so as not to make the matter worse and end badly.

The Qibao Glazed Sect is not something they can offend yet.

"Hmm!"

Ye Han looked at Zhu Zhuqing's pleading eyes, nodded, and let go of his hand.

But when he looked at Ning Rongrong, his eyes flashed with cold murderous intent.

Everyone present felt this murderous intention and was shocked.

Especially Li Yusong, he has lived in Douluo Continent for decades, and this is the first time he has encountered such an indifferent young man.

The murderous intent in his body is even rarer.

This person is definitely not simple,

Ning Rongrong was frightened by Ye Han's murderous intent and extremely cold eyes, and took a step back in fear, "You, what's that look in your eyes? Believe it or not, I will let Grandpa Jian and Grandpa Bone take care of you."

"Haha, that's right!"

"But I believe you have no chance of going back alive."

Ye Han narrowed his eyes slightly, and the murderous intention in his body became stronger, which scared Ning Rongrong and took another step back.

Zhu Zhuqing was afraid that he would be impulsive, so he held his arm tightly to signal him not to be impulsive.

"You..."

Ning Rongrong was completely frightened. She was trembling and did not dare to continue speaking, for fear that he would do something.

Dai Mubai, Tang San and Xiao Wu were a little happy when they saw this scene.

Especially Dai Mubai, he now wished that Ye Han could directly take action and hurt Ning Rongrong.

With the Qibao Glazed Sect’s protective character, they will definitely send someone to cause trouble for Ye Han.
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 8: Ning Rongrong is frightened. If you want to see my martial soul, you must see blood - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning and create a god-level family"
